| Shop | Why it stands out | Hours / notes |
|---|---|---|

| **Big Brand Tire & Service** | Full tire replacement, flat repair, wheel alignments, and maintenance; also appears in Tire Rack’s installer listings.[3][12] | 3687 Old Santa Rita Rd; Mon–Fri 8–6, Sat 8–4, Sun 9–4.[3] |

| **Tire Choice Auto Service** | Large brand selection and explicitly says it handles full tire replacement and installation.[14][19] | 4216 Rosewood Rd; open 7 days a week.[14] |
